summary: Iteration 8 ALTHEA v2 Self-Extension lattice tested end-to-end. Backend: 14 new pytest cases for /api/lattice/* (nodes spawn/list/delete with NODE-XXXX zero-pad, perception upsert by uppercased modality + delete 404, autonomous learn spawns node+memory tagged reflection/learn via Claude, lattice state aggregation, bridge STANDBY security stub with exact message + protocol uppercased + memory persisted). All 14 pass plus 30 regression tests from iter 1-7. Frontend: all six new slash commands (/spawn /lattice /perceive /forget-perception /learn /bridge) verified end-to-end via [data-testid=chat-input]+[data-testid=chat-send-btn]; correct network calls captured (POST nodes, GET state, POST/DELETE perception, POST learn, POST bridge). Permission toggle auto-perception mapping verified: POST body for geolocation -> modality=GPS endpoint=navigator.geolocation; notifications -> NOTIF/Notification API; toggle-OFF for granted permission fires DELETE /perception/{MOD}. camera/microphone/bluetooth/usb mapping confirmed in App.js modalityMap (couldn't trigger native grant in headless but per spec that's acceptable).

integration_issues.issue: Minor: For geolocation, peripheral POST fires immediately after requestGeo() without awaiting the async getCurrentPosition success callback. If the user denies geolocation, the lattice peripheral is still POSTed. Net effect: GPS link may register even on denial. Camera/mic/bluetooth/usb correctly only POST after successful grant since their code paths await navigator.* requests inside try/catch.

action_items: (Optional) In App.js togglePermission, for geolocation, wait for the success callback before POST /api/lattice/perception to avoid registering a GPS link on user denial.
critical_code_review_comments: lattice.py uses count_documents for next NODE id — vulnerable to a race if two spawn requests collide concurrently and to id reuse after DELETE /lattice/nodes. Consider a monotonic counter document or uuid + display index.
lattice.py serializes timestamps to ISO strings in inserts but deserializes only on list endpoints — keep this pattern uniform across all routers.
/lattice/state recomputes total_nodes by loading up to 2000 docs; for scale, prefer count_documents and project only id+activation for lattice_map.
ChatConsole.jsx is ~670 lines and contains all 18 slash commands inline. Consider extracting commands into a registry/map for maintainability (also enables unit testing each command in isolation).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed nodes/memories and wipe lattice nodes at module start; cleanup is implicit via wipe endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_althea_api.py (iter1-7 regression) and /app/backend/tests/test_lattice_v2.py (iter8 v2 lattice). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Lattice collections: althea_nodes, althea_peripheral, althea_memories. Bridge is a security stub by spec — never expect a real network connection.
